method: RESTART FROM FROZEN B0 COMPONENT UNIFORMITY, THE DEFINITION OF I_{sigma,i}, AND THE FACT THAT R_i IS STABLE; DO NOT USE THE PRIMARY PROOF'S CASE TEXT.

symbolic_replay.path_model: Let q_1,...,q_k be an arbitrary induced path in I_{sigma,i}. Because I_{sigma,i} is bipartite, path positions alternate between survivor nodes and component nodes.
symbolic_replay.representative_map: Map every survivor node v to itself and every component node C to an arbitrary c(C) in C.

arbitrary_pair_test.result: q_a,q_b are opposite-side adjacent nodes of I; incidence definition gives survivor complete to the component, hence their images are adjacent in G.

arbitrary_pair_test.condition: |a-b|>1 and positions a,b are on the same survivor side
arbitrary_pair_test.result: their images are distinct vertices in the same stable set R_i, hence nonadjacent in G.

arbitrary_pair_test.condition: |a-b|>1 and positions a,b are on the same component side
arbitrary_pair_test.result: their images lie in distinct connected components of G[Y0], hence nonadjacent in G.

arbitrary_pair_test.condition: |a-b|>1 and positions a,b are on opposite sides
arbitrary_pair_test.result: inducedness of the path in I gives a nonedge vC. B0 says v is complete or anticomplete to C; nonedge excludes complete, so v is anticomplete to C, hence the representative pair is nonadjacent in G.

symbolic_replay.dependence_on_k: NONE beyond the existence of path positions; the argument holds for every k>=1.
symbolic_replay.lifted_graph: Exactly the consecutive image pairs are edges; every nonconsecutive image pair is a nonedge. Therefore the image is an induced P_k.

recomputed_corollaries.reason: An induced P7 in I_{sigma,i} would lift to an induced P7 in G.
recomputed_corollaries.reason_import: Each I_{sigma,i} is bipartite by definition and P7-free by the replayed corollary.

limitations: No claim that the union I_sigma of the three layers has bounded mim-width.
No joint DP or shared-component boundary-state theorem is proved.
No global extension coloring is fixed by the auxiliary coloring.
No B1B synchronization gate is opened.
No full L2 repair or Lemma 11 P7 lift is proved.
